analyst_view.overall: Eighth-placed Stuttgart (13 pts from 10) host seventh-placed Frankfurt (15 pts) on Saturday at 18:30, both unbeaten in their last three league games and chasing the European places. Stuttgart play Inter in Milan tonight (Wednesday) and have only two full days before this match, but Sebastian Hoeneß has everyone back: Angelo Stiller and Luca Jaquez returned to the squad, and Leo Sauer travelled too, although the numbers still list Sauer and Diehl as out (with no effect on the goals). Frankfurt, under Adi Hütter, had no midweek game and Can Uzun is back in full training after a cold; only Jessic Ngankam is out. No referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.6 goals, a high figure driven by Stuttgart's attack at home; the last two meetings here both ended 3-2. Stiller and Jaquez being back should tighten Stuttgart, but they come off a Wednesday night at San Siro while Frankfurt are rested and have Uzun back. These roughly cancel, so I stay at 3.6.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.3 corners, already lifting Frankfurt (+5%) for their 35 corners in the last six. Stuttgart's full-strength wide players (Leweling, Führich, Mittelstädt) are what the numbers expect at home, so I stay at 10.3.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.1 cards, already nudged up for both teams' busier recent card counts. No referee has been named and the match has no derby edge beyond the race for Europe, so I stay at 4.1.

shots.text: The numbers say 30.3 shots, already raising Frankfurt by almost 19% because Stuttgart allowed 107 shots in their last six. Much of that came while Stiller, who controls Stuttgart's midfield, was out; he and defender Jaquez are now back, so I trim slightly (-3%) to about 29.4, a mild lean since Stuttgart may tire after Inter.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.0 shots on target, already raising Frankfurt (+10%) for their recent accuracy and trimming Stuttgart slightly. Stiller's return may cut Frankfurt's chances a little, but Stuttgart's attack is also back to full strength and Frankfurt are fresher, so I stay at 11.0.
